messages.text:
The verifier has now reached a pure CLI-surface mismatch: `--help` uses Clap’s expanded long-help layout because the mask option has `long_help` in `rust-reference/src/args.rs`.

I’m replacing the compact README-style help with the observed long-help text so the parser boundary matches the official CLI.
